meta.title: Volunteer with Friends of Animals
meta.description: Apply to volunteer with Friends of Animals, and follow your application.

volunteer.title: Volunteer with Friends of Animals
volunteer.lead: Help children and young people care for animals: with technology, content, outreach, running competitions, social media or building our community. We check everyone who will work near children.

outcome.applied: Application sent. Our community team will read it and tell you what they decide.
outcome.awaiting_guardian: Application sent. We have asked your parent or guardian to approve it. Our community team reads it once they have.
outcome.accepted: Thank you. You have accepted the current declarations.
outcome.declarations_required: Tick both boxes to accept the declarations.
outcome.declaration_outdated: A declaration changed while you were reading it. Read the new version, then accept it.
outcome.declaration_unpublished: The declarations aren't ready yet. Please try again later.
outcome.no_open_application: You have no application waiting, so there was nothing to accept.
outcome.invalid_transition: That application has already been decided or withdrawn.
outcome.invalid_input: Something in the form didn't come through. Please try again.

role.title: You're a volunteer
role.body: Thank you for helping. Our community team will be in touch about what you'll do.

reaccept.title: Accept the new declarations
reaccept.body: We have changed a declaration since you applied. Our community team can only approve your application once you have accepted the current version of both.

closed.title: Volunteering opens soon
closed.body: We aren't taking volunteer applications yet. Please come back later.

form.title: Apply to volunteer
form.lead: Tell us how you'd like to help and when you're free. If you are 14 to 17, your parent or guardian approves your application before our community team reads it.

problems.invalid_input: Check the parts of the form marked below.
problems.declarations_required: Tick both boxes to accept the declarations.
problems.applications_closed: We aren't taking volunteer applications at the moment. Nothing was sent.
problems.already_volunteer: You are already a volunteer, so there's no need to apply.
problems.application_open: You already have an application waiting. You can follow it on this page.
problems.under_min_age: Volunteers must be at least 14 years old. Nothing was sent.
problems.guardian_required: Volunteers under 18 need a parent or guardian on Friends of Animals to approve. Ask them to create an account, confirm they are your guardian and invite you to your own login from their children's page. Then apply again.
problems.declaration_unpublished: The declarations aren't ready yet. Please try again later.
problems.declaration_outdated: A declaration changed while you were reading it. Read the new version below, then tick its box again.
problems.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was sent. Please try again.

interests.legend: How would you like to help?
interests.error: Choose at least one way to help.

availability.hint: Tick the times you could usually help each week.
availability.error: Tick at least one time, and keep the note short.

note.label: Anything else about when you're free (optional)
note.hint: For example: school holidays only. Up to {max} characters.

dateOfBirth.label: Date of birth
dateOfBirth.hint: Volunteers must be at least 14. Under 18, a parent or guardian approves.

declarations.hint: Read both, then tick each box. We keep a record of the version you accepted.
declarations.error: Tick both boxes to accept the declarations.
declarations.safeguarding: I make the safeguarding declaration above
declarations.conduct: I accept the volunteer code of conduct above

self.awaiting_guardian: Your parent or guardian needs to approve your application. We have sent them a message.
self.guardian_declined: Your parent or guardian declined your application. You can talk to them and apply again.
self.submitted: Our community team is reading your application. We'll tell you what they decide.
self.declined: Our community team couldn't take your application further this time. You are welcome to apply again later.
self.withdrawn: You, or your guardian, withdrew this application. You can apply again.

guardian.awaiting_guardian: {name} has applied to volunteer. They need your approval before our community team reads it.
guardian.submitted: You approved {name}'s application. Our community team is reading it.
guardian.declined: Our community team couldn't take {name}'s application further this time.

staff.awaiting_guardian: Waiting for {name}'s guardian to approve. You can decide once they have.
staff.submitted: Waiting for a community manager to approve or decline.

outdated.self: We have changed a declaration since you applied. Accept the current version below so our community team can approve your application.
outdated.guardian: A declaration has changed since {name} applied. They need to accept the current version on their volunteering page.
outdated.staff: A declaration has changed since the applicant accepted it. They must accept the current version before you can approve.

outcome.approved: Approved. {name}'s application is now with our community team.
outcome.invalid_transition: That application has already been decided or withdrawn.

decide.body: As {name}'s parent or guardian, your approval is your consent to them volunteering. Our community team then reads the application and checks it.
